name: American Electric Company, LLC
old_description: With over seven decades of unparalleled experience, American Electric stands as Hawaii's gold standard in electrical services. Our reputation, built on trust and excellence since 1946, illuminates our commitment to powering the Aloha spirit.
about:
Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Mililani, Hawaii, American Electric Company, LLC has spent more than seven decades as a licensed electrical contractor serving the islands. The company began as a local electrical service provider and has grown into a full-service firm handling industrial, commercial, and residential projects across the state.

The firm delivers a broad range of electrical construction and maintenance services, including design-build projects that use BIM modeling, TotalStation layout, Revit coordination, and prefabrication. It also provides high-voltage system design, installation, testing, and commissioning for power plants, manufacturing facilities, and data centers. Additional capabilities cover ultrasonic testing, de-energized maintenance, guaranteed service programs through its TEGG® contractor affiliation, emergency repairs, installations, modifications, and power-quality diagnostics. The company also installs lighting, circuit panels, generators, EV chargers, and offers controls, telecom, and alternative-energy solutions.

Customers span homeowners, business owners, property managers, and general contractors in sectors such as alternative energy, industrial manufacturing, power generation, data centers, and commercial real estate. The company cites work on iconic landmarks as well as residential homes, and emphasizes coordination with other trades to keep projects on budget and on schedule.

American Electric differentiates itself through a customer-first approach that stresses transparent pricing, timely completion, and safety education. Its electricians undergo regular training to stay current with codes and technology, and the firm promotes equipment guarantees and 24/7 emergency response as part of its service commitment.
